harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Pinned curl to its current version on node1 using dnf versionlock (after resolving a GPG key import issue blocking the plugin install), verified curl is excluded from a simulated dnf update while libcurl (a separate package) still updates normally, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a healthy baseline, restarted node1 via shutdown -r now, confirmed the boot ID changed after the node came back, and re-verified curl's version and the versionlock entry survived the reboot.
actions_performed: Captured baseline: RHEL 10.0, curl-8.9.1-5.el10.x86_64 installed
Diagnosed dnf install failure of python3-dnf-plugin-versionlock: RPM GPG key parsing error during install
Inspected /etc/pki/rpm-gpg and repo gpgkey config; found redhat-release key present on disk but not imported into rpm db
Manually imported RPM-GPG-KEY-redhat-release with rpm --import, then successfully installed python3-dnf-plugin-versionlock
Added versionlock for curl (curl-0:8.9.1-5.el10.*) and listed locks to confirm
Ran dnf update simulation (tsflags=test) and confirmed curl package does not appear in the transaction (only unrelated libcurl package updates)
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime, curl version, versionlock list
Issued sudo shutdown -r now on node1 with acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, confirming node came back online
Captured post-restart boot_id/uptime (changed) and re-verified curl version and versionlock entry intact

evidence.requirement: curl version-lock installed and applied on node1
evidence.summary: python3-dnf-plugin-versionlock installed and 'dnf versionlock add curl' successfully locked curl-0:8.9.1-5.el10.*

evidence.requirement: system update leaves curl at its current version
evidence.summary: Simulated dnf update (tsflags=test) transaction excludes the curl package entirely; only libcurl (a separate, unlocked package) is upgraded, and rpm -q curl remains 8.9.1-5.el10 after the simulation
Captured boot_id d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6, uptime since 08:24:34, curl 8.9.1 functional, and versionlock list showing curl locked
sudo shutdown -r now issued in background with disown; command returned before the node disconnected the session

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity proving restart occurred
evidence.summary: Exec calls timed out/reset while node1 was down, then succeeded again; post-restart boot_id changed to c9eeaf65-2226-4750-9fb9-d7b56e9ebed4 with new uptime 08:26:27, proving an actual reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of curl version and versionlock state
evidence.summary: After restart, rpm -q curl still shows curl-8.9.1-5.el10.x86_64, curl --version works, and dnf versionlock list still shows curl locked, confirming the version hold persisted across reboot
